description: This file defines the CasesQuickCreate class, a PHP class extending QuickCreate, responsible for handling the quick creation of 'Cases' in SuiteCRM. It sets up form processing, JavaScript integration, and UI options for creating case records.

classes.name: CasesQuickCreate
classes.description: A PHP class for handling quick creation of case records in SuiteCRM, extending the QuickCreate class.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Prepares the quick create form, assigns options, initializes JavaScript, and encodes popup request data for creating a new case.
